title: Microsoft Office templates
slide_intent: Make office templates easy to locate because everyday documents are repeated encounters with a city’s identity.
strategic_value: Named Word and PowerPoint resources can help Helsinki employees reuse shared document structures.
demonstration: This webpage component introduces Microsoft 365 document templates for Word and PowerPoint beneath a Microsoft Office templates heading and ends with an Open all control.
practical_value: Locate the appropriate office template family before making a document.

content_islands.name: Office template header
content_islands.spec: Keep the heading, Word/PowerPoint description and expansion control together.

reference_purposes.Application: The component identifies Word and PowerPoint as the Microsoft 365 template contexts.
